name_note: Most genomes GTDB places here carry the NCBI name Faecalibacterium prausnitzii, reflecting the recent split of that species; the name Faecalibacterium wellingii was proposed for strain HTF-F.

sentences.text: Faecalibacterium wellingii is the name proposed for strains HTF-F and HTF-128, which represent a novel species, with HTF-F as the type strain.
The genus Faecalibacterium is described as one of the most important butyrate producers in the human intestinal tract and has been widely linked to health.
The species description rested on phylogenomic analysis of whole-genome and 16S rRNA gene sequences together with chemotaxonomic analysis by MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry.

A study using qPCR with rpoA-based species-specific primers quantified nine species-level groups within Faecalibacterium in faeces of 88 healthy Japanese adults; five species were detected only occasionally.
That study indicates that F. prausnitzii is not the predominant Faecalibacterium species in the healthy Japanese adults it included.

references.title: Description of Faecalibacterium wellingii sp. nov. and two Faecalibacterium taiwanense strains, aiding to the reclassification of Faecalibacterium species.

references.title: Species-level quantification of Faecalibacterium spp. in faeces of healthy Japanese adults.
